check_obstacle_vision_lidar: check if there is an obstacle in front of the robot using vision point cloud and optional lidar scan
detect_lidar_obstacle: detect obstacles from a lidar scan by checking if points fall within a bounding box in front of the robot
extract_ground_plane: extract the ground plane from a point cloud scan using RANSAC and return non-ground points
crop_points_in_front: crop points from a point cloud that are directly in front of the robot within a distance range
create_o3d_pointcloud: create an Open3D point cloud object from numpy arrays of 3D points and RGB colors
